responsibility: Implements Temporary Expression Replacement during out-of-SSA conversion. Working block-local over coalesced partitions and liveness information, it tracks single-use replaceable SSA definitions, records partition and virtual-memory dependencies that can invalidate those expressions, decides which RHS expressions can safely substitute their lone uses without crossing kills, calls, or clobbering hazards, and returns the bitmap of SSA versions to inline so RTL expansion later sees larger combined expressions.
same_name_distinction: This .c file contains the TER analysis that scans basic blocks, tracks partition and virtual-memory kills, decides which single-use SSA definitions are safe to inline, and computes the replacement bitmap. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-ter.h, it is not merely the minimal API declaring the TER entry point and dump helper.
